question: Does a viewport-fixed preview preserve the article reading point during real internal Tab focus, compared with the current document-absolute preview?
alternatives: A: current absolute positioning with document coordinates
B: fixed positioning with viewport coordinates
decisionChangingEvidence: The same actual ArrowDown / Tab / Tab / Escape sequence, same article, fonts and case input retains windowY and hash in B, while reproducing the known A short-screen shift, and normal focus/More visibility stays valid.
smallestFailure: Any windowY/hash change between entered preview and internal citation focus, or clipped More/focus owner lost.
stopRule: Run each of three cases once per variant, save all observations including failed assertions, stop without a production edit; do not loop to get a preferred outcome.

cases.fixture: 24 local paragraphs added to a cloned-browser public note only; no source article edit
